verdict.rationale: Stable does offer check deposit as a feature ("Deposit: Automate check deposits", and a Check object representing transcribed physical checks) but the evidence never publishes concrete terms — no list of supported banks, no per-deposit fee schedule, no turnaround time SLA, and no explanation of what happens to the physical check after deposit. Missing for 10: supported-bank list, fee schedule per deposit, turnaround-time commitment, and physical-check disposition policy.
